regions.summary: Hefei's old centre inside the moat ring: Luyang district (Yaozhou, Bozhou Lu, Xiaoyaojin, Shuanggang) plus the Changhuai, Fangmiao and station subdistricts of Yaohai.

candidates.name: Hefei
candidates.meaning: "Joined Fei": the Fei River (a branch of the Huai) and the Nanfei River meet near here, an etymology given since the Shiji.
candidates.fit: City rule: holds the old walled town, Luzhou prefecture seat and the Xiaoyaojin and Sanxiaokou centre; 71% Luyang, 28% Yaohai.
candidates.source_note: “合肥”之名，最早出现在...《史记·货殖列传》中；市区人口652万

candidates.name: Luzhou
candidates.meaning: Name of the prefecture (Sui to Yuan) and, as Luzhou fu, the Ming-Qing prefecture, from the ancient Lu state north-west of the city.
candidates.fit: CHGIS puts the seat of Luzhou, Luzhou fu and Luzhou lu in this region (583-1911); Luzhou is also a common short name for Hefei.
candidates.recognisability: Zh-wiki lists 庐州 as an alias of the city; only useful if Anita wants a name other than Hefei.
candidates.source_note: 合肥市…又称庐州; 隋朝初年…改合州为庐州

regions.notes: Luzhou in Sichuan is the same romanisation (different characters, 泸州); fine under the repeat rule. Hefei is the clear pick.

regions.summary: East Hefei: Yaohai district's industrial park, Longgang, Qilitang, Daxing and Modian, with the Feidong new town edge.

candidates.name: Yaohai
candidates.meaning: "Jade sea": from Yaohai Park, whose name echoes the saying "Yaochi (jade pool) in heaven, Yaohai on earth".
candidates.fit: Yaohai district is 85% of the region's people (though only 39% of the district; the rest lies in region 1 and 4).
candidates.source_note: 瑶海区得名于境内的瑶海公园（原意为“天上瑶池，地下瑶海”）

candidates.name: Longgang
candidates.meaning: "Dragon ridge": the Longgang economic development zone and former Longgang town of Feidong, annexed to Yaohai in 2002.
candidates.fit: Holds the Longgang zone (14.5% of the region), but the name is a small township and a very common Chinese place name (Shenzhen).
candidates.recognisability: Mostly about Longgang district in Shenzhen.
candidates.source_note: 肥东县的…龙岗镇…划归瑶海区管辖

regions.notes: Yaohai is also the 28% eastern share of region 1 and 4, but is the clear owner of this one.

regions.summary: Western Hefei: Shushan district (Jinggang, hi-tech zone, Hupo, Wuliduan, Bijiashan, Nanqi, Xiyuan, Sanliyan).

candidates.name: Shushan
candidates.meaning: "Shu hill": named for Dashushan, the highest hill in Hefei city; the Shu character is the same as for Sichuan but the hill is said to resemble a Shu mountain.
candidates.fit: Shushan district is 90% of the region's people and the region holds 57% of the district.
candidates.source_note: 因合肥城区最高峰大蜀山位于该区西部而得名

candidates.name: Dashushan
candidates.meaning: "Great Shu hill": 284 m, Hefei's tallest hill, now a forest park; its snow scene was first of the Luyang eight views.
candidates.fit: The hill lies just west of this region in Shushan district; the name stands for the district.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 51 hits with Anhui, top ones about this hill.
candidates.source_note: 位于安徽省合肥市蜀山区西部，是合肥城区最高的山，海拔284米

regions.notes: Tian'e Hu (Swan Lake) is in this district's south-east, split between regions 3 and 4, so not a good name for either.

regions.summary: South-east of the old city: Baohe district's Wanghu, Changqing, Wuhu Lu and Bao Gong subdistricts plus the Mingguang Lu, Datong Lu and Heping Lu subdistricts of Yaohai.

candidates.name: Baohe
candidates.meaning: "Bao river": the moat-side pond south-east of the old city, linked to Bao Zheng (Bao Gong), the Song official born in Hefei.
candidates.fit: Baohe is 65% of the region's people; the region holds 74% of the district, including Bao Gong subdistrict and the Bao River itself.
candidates.source_note: 因合肥旧城东南的包河得名

candidates.name: Wanghu
candidates.meaning: "Lake view": the largest subdistrict here, facing Chao Lake.
candidates.fit: Largest single subdistrict (25% of the region) but a modern neighbourhood name.
candidates.recognisability: Not checked; just a subdistrict of Baohe.
candidates.source_note: 包河区5街道：包公街道 芜湖路街道 常青街道 望湖街道 同安街道

regions.notes: Region 5 is also mostly Baohe district; only one of the two can take the name.

regions.summary: South-east edge towards Chao Lake: Luogang (old airport), Yandun, Feihe, Yicheng, Dawei, Cuozhen, Binhu new area.

candidates.name: Binhu
candidates.meaning: "Lakeshore": the Binhu New Area, Hefei's planned new city on the north shore of Chao Lake (491 km2), with the Anhui Celebrities Hall and the Crossing the Yangtze memorial.
candidates.fit: The region holds the Binhu Shiji community and neighbours Dawei and Feihe on the shore; the new area lies mostly in Baohe and Feixi, so it spans regions 5 and 6.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 210 hits with Anhui, top ones about this new area; not an official admin unit.
candidates.source_note: 合肥市正在建设中的一个新城区…行政上仍然属于肥西县和包河区

candidates.name: Luogang
candidates.meaning: Luogang town, site of Hefei's old airport (1977-2013), now Luogang Central Park; the name means roughly "Luo ridge" (Luo is a surname).
candidates.fit: Largest subdistrict (20%); known for the old airport which sits in the middle of the region.
candidates.recognisability: 172 zh-wiki hits with Anhui; top hits are the old airport (Hefei Luogang International Airport).
candidates.source_note: 位于合肥市包河区骆岗镇，于1977年投入使用，是合肥的前民用机场

candidates.name: Baohe
candidates.meaning: "Bao river": named after the Bao River pond by the old city (see region 4).
candidates.fit: Baohe district is 78% of the region's people, but the district name is better kept for region 4, which holds the pond and most of the district's people.
candidates.source_note: 因合肥旧城东南的包河得名

regions.notes: Luogang is a town name, not an area name, but it is the one familiar place here.

regions.summary: South-west of the city: Shangpai (Feixi's seat), Taohua, and the Lotus, Haiheng and Linhu community areas of Shushan.

candidates.name: Shangpai
candidates.meaning: Upper Pai: town on the Pai River, seat of Feixi county since 1949.
candidates.fit: 23% of the region's people and the seat of Feixi (which holds 39% of the region).
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; Feixi county seat.
candidates.source_note: 1949年6月正式将县治设在上派河镇

candidates.name: Paihe
candidates.meaning: "Pai River": a short river from Feixi into the west of Chao Lake.
candidates.fit: Runs through Shangpai and the region before reaching Chao Lake.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 152 hits with Anhui but mostly road and bridge names.
candidates.source_note: 合肥长江水系：南淝河、派河、丰乐河…

regions.notes: Feixi (county) is 39% of the people but the county's main body lies outside the batch, so its name probably belongs to a larger region.
